gaps: partial (mixed-origin) rows carry no binary label and are unmeasured here (U4 spine)
only the default/train split is evaluated; dev/test splits are not

Wilson intervals treat rows as independent; rows within a document group are correlated — group counts per slice are reported and AUROC/AUPRC CIs are cluster-bootstrapped over document groups, but the FPR/TPR Wilson intervals do not adjust for clustering
generators are 2026-era (gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-nano); Qwen3-8B is the held-out generator and is not in this sample

licence_verification.basis: Card states the dataset is released under Apache-2.0 and is intended for research and evaluation of AI-text detection systems — exactly this use.

results.licence_verified_how: live Hugging Face dataset cards re-read 2026-11-16 (crawled 10:09 UTC): OpAI-Bench1/OpAI-Bench 'Licensing and Reuse' section; TheItCrOw/GhostWriter 'Licenses and Sources' table lines 340-368

n56_slice_resolution.identity: the n=56 slice IS OpAI-Bench: the default/train U1 500-row strided sample, n_human=56, n_ai=55, Wilson 95% upper 0.064196 (EV-20261110-human-fpr)
n56_slice_resolution.resolution: YES — licensed data existed to expand it, and it was expanded twice: first to n_human=218 in the train-2000 sample (supported record evr-20261110-opai-bench-builtin-heuristic, Wilson upper 0.0173), and now to a pooled, document-grouped, partitioned final-test slice with n_human=146 and n_ai=147. The final-test slice below is the held-out expansion: it was partitioned before evaluation and influenced no threshold, calibration, or selection decision.

results.operating_point: builtin-heuristic native verdict (analyze_text); no score threshold; no threshold was fitted, no calibration was fitted — the operating point is fixed by the detector

partition.method: group = document_hash_id; bucket = int(sha256(group), 16) % 10; buckets 0-2 fit, 3-4 dev/selection, 5-9 final-test. All 9 versions of a document land in one partition, so no near-duplicate of a final-test row appears in fit/dev. Assignment uses row identity only, never a detector score. Fit/dev were never scored and no decision was fitted on them.

provenance.dataset_version: OpAI-Bench1/OpAI-Bench snapshot 2026-11-16 (no versioned release); pooled from the U1 500-row strided sample (2026-11-06) and the phase-shifted 2000-row strided sample (2026-11-10)
provenance.label_provenance: only v0 (ai_sentence_ratio 0.0, pure human) and v8 (ai_sentence_ratio 1.0, fully machine) rows carry binary labels; partial rows (0 < ai_sentence_ratio < 1) carry no binary label and are the U4 spine, not U1 evidence
provenance.normalization_provenance: rows mapped by textforensics.datasets.map_row('opai_bench') at fetch time; cached normalised JSONL verified by SHA-256
provenance.sampling: strided (both pooled samples); see EV-20261110-dataset-opai-bench for the phase-shift method
